items.body: - **AssemblyAI STT 3.7 Realtime Agent**: supported through LiveKit Inference as `assemblyai/assemblyai-stt-3-7-realtime-agent`. - **GPT Live**: inference HTTP refusals now raise `APIStatusError` rather than `APIConnectionError`. Update exception handlers accordingly. - **OpenAI decisions**: direct `DecisionModel()` requests now default to `gpt-6-luna`; the inference name remains `openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions`. - **Gemini Live**: inference sessions now retain Gemini’s own turn detection to avoid missing replies.
